name: log_temp_files
description: Logs temporary file names and sizes when files exceed the specified size in kilobytes; logs occur at file deletion.
symptoms: Poor query performance due to spilling to disk
Inability to diagnose low work_mem issues
Unexplained disk I/O spikes during queries
tuning_tips: Set to a small positive value (e.g., 1024 for 1MB) to log large temp files during investigation; set to -1 to disable. Monitor logs to identify queries spilling to disk, then tune work_mem accordingly.
